recipe.title: Creamy Chicken Pasta
recipe.description: A quick and comforting pasta dish with tender chicken, creamy sauce, and Parmesan cheese. Perfect for an easy lunch or dinner.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water following the package instructions. Reserve a small cup of the cooking water, then drain.

steps.title: Prepare the chicken
steps.text: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a pan and cook the chicken until cooked through. Add the garlic and stir until fragrant.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Lower the heat, add the cream, and stir in the Parmesan. Add a little reserved pasta water if the sauce is too thick.

steps.title: Combine and serve
steps.text: Add the pasta to the pan and stir to coat. Season with salt and black pepper, then serve with fresh parsley.

reviews.name: Alex
reviews.text: Easy to follow and perfect for a weekday dinner.

reviews.name: Sam
reviews.text: I added mushrooms and a little extra Parmesan.

reviews.name: Jamie
reviews.text: The pasta water tip made the sauce really smooth.
